ranked_facts.why: The flat rod electroretinogram is more characteristic of Retinitis Pigmentosa (RP) than Enhanced S-cone Syndrome (ESCS), as ESCS typically shows an elevated rod electroretinogram response.

The complete loss of photoreceptors, ellipsoid zone, and retinal pigment epithelium in the superotemporal region is more consistent with the progressive degeneration seen in Retinitis Pigmentosa (RP) than the relatively preserved retinal structure in Enhanced S-cone Syndrome (ESCS).
